title: Accessible Disability Mirror Placard: Hang When Parked, Remove Before Driving

no_head_on_same_lane.note: No head-on opposing vehicles in same lane; right panel shows one SUV ahead in same direction.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Both panels show left-hand drive with driver and steering wheel on left side.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signals visible in either panel.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Right panel shows US layout with double-yellow centerline on left and white edge line on right, following same-direction traffic; left panel is a parking stall with no traffic violation.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers or words visible; only blank shapes and white wheelchair pictogram icons on blue sign, pavement, and hangtag.

scene_match.note: Left shows hangtag on mirror while parked in blue wheelchair stall; right shows clear mirror while driving with hangtag stowed in console, exactly as prompted.

result.summary: Two-panel comparison correctly teaches hang-when-parked and remove-before-driving with no rule violations.

teaching_correct.note: Clearly teaches hangtag displayed only when parked in accessible stall and stowed while driving to avoid obstruction.

result.what_i_see: Two-panel interior car view: left shows driver parked facing a blue wheelchair stall with blue wheelchair hangtag hanging from rearview mirror; right shows driver on a coastal road with clear mirror and the blue hangtag stowed in the open center console.
